group: Clone with empty sections and no TSIG records

cases.expected: A new Message instance whose sections array has the same length as the original, all entries are null; header is a distinct clone (different object but equal content); querytsig and generatedTsig are null. Modifying the original's header or sections after cloning does not affect the clone.
cases.description: Verify that clone() correctly handles the case where `sections` contains only null entries and both TSIG fields are null. The method should create a new sections array with nulls, clone the header, and leave TSIG fields null.

group: Clone with populated sections (non‑null lists) and no TSIG

cases.expected: The cloned Message has a sections array of the same length as the original. Each non‑null list in the original is cloned into a new LinkedList instance (different object) containing the same Record objects. Adding or removing a Record from a list in the original after cloning does not affect the corresponding list in the clone. The header is a distinct clone (different object but equal content). querytsig and generatedTsig remain null.
cases.description: Verify deep‑copy of the sections lists while preserving record references, and independence of the sections array and header when TSIG fields are absent.

group: Clone with mixed null and non‑null sections

cases.expected: The clone’s sections array has the same length as the source. Positions that were null in the source remain null in the clone. Positions that contained a non‑null List are replaced by a new LinkedList instance (different object) with the same elements. No TSIG records are present. Header is cloned separately.
cases.description: Ensure that the cloning logic correctly handles a mixture of null and populated section entries, preserving nulls and deep‑copying only the existing lists.

group: Clone with empty but non‑null sections

cases.expected: For each section that originally held an empty LinkedList (non‑null but size 0), the clone contains a new empty LinkedList (different object). The sections array length matches the original. Header is cloned. No TSIG records are present.
cases.description: Confirm that even empty lists are duplicated rather than shared, guaranteeing that later modifications to one list do not affect the other.

cases.expected: The cloned Message’s header is a distinct Header instance (object identity differs) but equals the original header in content. After cloning, mutating the original header (e.g., changing the ID or flags) does not change the header inside the clone, and vice‑versa.
cases.description: Validate that Message.clone() performs a deep clone of the Header object, not a shallow reference copy.

cases.expected: The clone contains a querytsig field that is a distinct TSIGRecord instance (different object) whose content equals the original’s querytsig. The generatedTsig field remains null. Header and sections are cloned as usual.
cases.description: Test that when querytsig is non‑null, clone() invokes cloneRecord() and stores a separate copy, ensuring no shared mutable state.

cases.expected: The clone’s generatedTsig field is a distinct TSIGRecord instance equal in content to the original’s generatedTsig. querytsig remains null. Header and sections are cloned correctly.
cases.description: Verify that generatedTsig is deep‑cloned via cloneRecord() when it is set.

group: Clone with both queryTSIG and generatedTSIG present

cases.expected: Both querytsig and generatedTsig are cloned into separate TSIGRecord instances (different objects) with content equal to the originals. Header and sections are deep‑copied as usual.
cases.description: Ensure that the method handles cloning of both TSIG fields simultaneously without overwriting or sharing references.

cases.expected: The cloned Message has a sections array of length 0 (same as source). No NullPointerException is thrown. Header is cloned. Both TSIG fields are null.
cases.description: Check that clone() works correctly when the internal sections array is empty, a corner case that could expose index handling bugs.

group: Clone when sections array is null

cases.description: Invoke Message.clone() on a Message instance whose internal `sections` field has been set to null (via reflection). The method attempts to read `sections.length`, which should throw a NullPointerException.
Invoke Message.clone() on a Message instance whose `header` field has been set to null (via reflection). The call to `header.clone()` should result in a NullPointerException.

Create a Message with a non‑null `querytsig` that is a mock or subclass of TSIGRecord whose `cloneRecord()` method throws an IOException. Calling clone() should propagate the IOException (SneakyThrows converts it to an unchecked exception, but the original exception type remains IOException).
Create a Message with a non‑null `generatedTsig` that is a mock/subclass of TSIGRecord whose `cloneRecord()` method throws an IOException. The clone() call should propagate this IOException.

Define a subclass of Message that does NOT implement Cloneable. Invoke the inherited clone() method on an instance of this subclass. The call to `super.clone()` will throw CloneNotSupportedException, which is re‑thrown by the method (via SneakyThrows).
